description: This is a Java test class for regex pattern validation, specifically testing the regex patterns defined in the RegexPatterns class for entity names, feature IDs, namespaces, message subjects, and IDs within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.id package.

classes.name: RegexPatternsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for validating regex patterns used in entity ID and name validation.

methods.name: entityNameRegex
methods.description: Tests that entity names match the permitted regex pattern and that invalid names do not.

methods.name: featureRegex
methods.description: Tests for the feature ID regex pattern with valid and invalid feature IDs.

methods.name: namespaceRegex
methods.description: Tests for namespace regex pattern with valid and invalid namespaces.

methods.name: subjectRegex
methods.description: Tests for message subject regex pattern with valid and invalid subjects.

methods.name: idRegex
methods.description: Tests for full ID pattern with combinations of valid and invalid namespace and feature ID strings.
